question: Spot the error: She cans easily solve this complex mathematical problem in a few minutes.
solution: lain: Rule (2) of Modals: Modal Auxiliary verbs का V1, V2, V3, ing-form या s/es-form नहीं होता है। इनका प्रयोग सभी Numbers तथा persons के Subjects के साथ हमेशा एक ही रूप में होता है। अर्थात् 'can' में 's' लगाकर 'cans' बनाना पूरी तरह गलत है। सही शब्द 'can' होगा।

question: Spot the error: Everyone could make a mistake when trying to learn a completely new language.
solution: lain: Rule (3) of CAN: 'Can' का प्रयोग theoretical possibility (सैद्धांतिक सम्भावना) को अभिव्यक्त करने के लिए किया जाता है। यहाँ गलती करना एक आम बात/सिद्धांत है, इसलिए 'could' के स्थान पर 'can' का प्रयोग होगा (Everyone can make a mistake)।

question: Spot the error: Please be careful, there can be a bomb under your seat.
solution: lain: Rule (4) of COULD: 'Could' का प्रयोग remote possibility (क्षीण सम्भावना / दूर की सम्भावना) व्यक्त करने के लिए किया जाता है। बम होने की सम्भावना एक remote possibility है, इसलिए 'can' के स्थान पर 'could' का प्रयोग सही होगा।

question: Spot the error: Because of the heavy rain, I cannot be able to attend the meeting tomorrow.
solution: lain: Note: 'able to' का प्रयोग 'can/could' के साथ न करें क्योंकि दोनों ही क्षमता (capacity) दर्शाते हैं। ऐसा करके हम वाक्य को 'superfluous' (ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा) बना देते हैं। सही वाक्य होगा: "I cannot attend..." या "I will not be able to attend..."।

question: Spot the error: We eat healthy food daily so that we might live a long and disease-free life.
solution: lain: Rule (3) of MAY: यदि Principal clause Present Tense में हो तथा subordinate clause 'that'/'so that'/'in order that' से प्रारम्भ हो तथा इससे purpose (उद्देश्य) का बोध हो, तो subordinate clause में 'may' का प्रयोग होता है। यहाँ 'eat' (present) है, इसलिए 'might' की जगह 'may' आएगा।

question: Spot the error: He stays in five-star hotels and always travels by business class flights. He may be very rich.
solution: lain: Rule (5) of MUST: अगर सम्भावना (possibility) बहुत अधिक हो तो 'Must' का प्रयोग करें। जो व्यक्ति फाइव-स्टार होटल और फ्लाइट में घूमता है, उसका अमीर होना लगभग तय है। इसलिए 'may' की जगह 'must' आएगा (He must be very rich)।

question: Spot the error: We may possibly come tomorrow to help you with the house shifting.
solution: lain: Note of MAY/MIGHT: 'May' एवं 'Might' के साथ 'Possibly' एवं 'likely' का प्रयोग न करें क्योंकि दोनों ही सम्भावना दर्शाते हैं। यह 'Superfluous' error है। यहाँ से 'possibly' को हटाना होगा।

question: Spot the error: The notice board clearly says that trespassers will be prosecuted strictly.
solution: lain: Rule (1) Note of SHALL: 'Shall' का प्रयोग Second और Third person के subjects (He, she, it, they) के साथ Command (आदेश), Promise (वादा), Threat (धमकी), Determination (दृढ़ संकल्प), या Compulsion (अनिवार्यता) व्यक्त करने के लिए किया जाता है। यहाँ trespassers को धमकी/आदेश है, इसलिए 'will' के स्थान पर 'shall' आएगा (Trespassers shall be prosecuted)।

question: Spot the error: Let us dance together and enjoy the party tonight, will we?
solution: lain: Rule (2) of SHALL: 'Let us / let's' से शुरू होने वाले Imperative sentences के question tags में हमेशा 'shall' का प्रयोग होता है। इसलिए 'will we?' गलत है, सही जवाब 'shall we?' होगा।

question: Spot the error: He hoped that he will definitely pass the civil services examination this year.
solution: lain: Note of SHALL/WILL: अगर वाक्य Past tense से शुरू हो (He hoped), तो आगे 'Will/Shall' का प्रयोग नहीं होता, बल्कि उनके past form 'would/should' का प्रयोग होगा। यहाँ 'will' की जगह 'would' आएगा।

question: Spot the error: If I will come to Delhi next week, I will definitely meet you.
solution: lain: Rule of Conditionals: अगर दो कार्य भविष्य में एक के बाद एक हों, और दूसरा कार्य पहले कार्य के होने पर निर्भर करे, तो पहला कार्य Simple Present Tense में और दूसरा Simple Future Tense में होगा। 'If, as soon as, provided, unless, until' आदि के बाद simple future tense का प्रयोग नहीं होता है। सही वाक्य: "If I come..." होगा।

question: Spot the error: I would rather die with honor then beg for mercy from the enemy.
solution: lain: Rule (2) of WOULD: 'Would' का प्रयोग 'preference' (पसंद/प्राथमिकता) को व्यक्त करने के लिए किया जाता है। ऐसे वाक्यों में 'rather' का प्रयोग होता है, और जब दो विकल्पों का उल्लेख हो, तो हमेशा 'than' (T-H-A-N) का प्रयोग होता है, 'then' (T-H-E-N) का नहीं।

question: Spot the error: If I was a bird, I would fly high in the sky without any restrictions.
solution: lain: Rule (5) of WOULD: अगर वाक्य काल्पनिक पद (Present या Past की कोरी कल्पना) से सम्बंधित हो, तो सभी subjects के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है। (I wish, as though, if, as if, would that, suppose आदि के साथ 'was' नहीं आता)। सही वाक्य: "If I were a bird" होगा।

question: Spot the error: He ran as fast as he could lest he will miss the last local train.
solution: lain: Rule (3) of SHOULD: 'Should' का प्रयोग 'lest' के बाद negative purpose (नकारात्मक उद्देश्य) को व्यक्त करने के लिए किया जाता है। 'Lest' के साथ हमेशा 'should' का प्रयोग होता है, 'will' का नहीं। (Lest he should miss the train)।

question: Spot the error: As an obedient citizen of this country, we ought love our country.
solution: lain: Rule (1) of OUGHT TO: Ought to का प्रयोग moral obligation (नैतिक कर्तव्य) या duty को व्यक्त करने के लिए किया जाता है। Auxiliaries के नियमानुसार 'Ought' और 'Used' के बाद हमेशा infinitive 'to + V1' का प्रयोग होता है। सही प्रयोग "we ought to love" होगा।

question: Spot the error: He uses to study till 10 p.m every day and then goes to bed.
solution: lain: Rule of USED TO: 'Use to' या 'uses to' का प्रयोग Present routine action को व्यक्त करने के लिए नहीं होता है बल्कि इसके लिए Simple Present Tense का प्रयोग होता है। सही वाक्य होगा: "He studies till 10 p.m..."।

question: Spot the error: I am used to get up very late in the morning on Sundays.
solution: lain: Note of USED TO: 'Verb (is/am/are/was/were) + used to' के बाद हमेशा 'V1 + ing' (Gerund) का प्रयोग होता है, और यह habitual action को दर्शाता है। सही वाक्य: "I am used to getting up..." होगा।

question: Spot the error: Since he is completely dedicated, he is looking forward to meet you.
solution: lain: Note of Preposition 'TO': कई Verbs/adjective/phrase के बाद 'to' का प्रयोग होता है। यहाँ 'to' के बाद V1 का प्रयोग नहीं होगा बल्कि 'V1 + ing' का प्रयोग होगा। जैसे: addicted to, look forward to, given to, prone to आदि। इसलिए 'to meet' की जगह 'to meeting' होगा।

question: Spot the error: I need help him immediately because he is in deep financial trouble.
solution: lain: Rule of DARE & NEED: 'Need' एवं 'Dare' का प्रयोग modal के रूप में Positive (+ve) वाक्यों में नहीं होता। अगर इनका प्रयोग main verb के रूप में +ve वाक्यों में हो, तो इनके बाद 'to + V1' का प्रयोग होता है। सही वाक्य: "I need to help him" होगा।

question: Spot the error: You need not to come to the office tomorrow as it is a public holiday.
solution: lain: Rule of DARE & NEED: अगर need एवं dare का प्रयोग helping verb (modal) के रूप में हो, तो Negative (-ve) वाक्यों में need एवं dare के बाद 'to' का प्रयोग नहीं होता (Direct infinitive आता है)। सही वाक्य: "You need not come tomorrow" होगा।

question: Spot the error: You should have work hard during your exams to get better grades.
solution: lain: Rule of Modals in Perfect: Modals का प्रयोग 'Perfect' में करने पर formula "Sub + modal + have + V3 + obj" होता है। इसलिए 'should have' के बाद V1 (work) नहीं, V3 (worked) का प्रयोग होगा। इसका hidden meaning (छिपा हुआ अर्थ) यह है कि आपने कड़ी मेहनत नहीं की थी।

question: Spot the error: To feed her large family, the poor woman have to work extremely hard.
solution: lain: Rule of PRIMARY AUXILIARY VERBS (Have): Have + infinitive का प्रयोग forced action (दबाव में किया जाने वाला कार्य) को दर्शाने के लिए किया जाता है। चूँकि subject 'the poor woman' Singular (एकवचन) है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'has to work' आएगा, न कि 'have to work' Bhai, gussa bilkul jayaz hai aapka! question: Identify the error in the sentence: Practice makes a man perfect, so you must practice the questions given in the assignment.
solution: lain: Rule (1): 'Must' ek modal verb hai jiske baad Verb aani chahiye, Noun nahi. Dono shabdon mein antar samjhein: * Practice (Noun) - अभ्यास * Practise (Verb) - अभ्यास करना (Aakhiri page par iska example bhi hai: Practise the questions...). Atah C me 'practice' ki jagah 'practise' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: My teacher gave me a very good advise regarding my future career.
solution: lain: Rule (2): Yahan 'good' ek adjective hai jiske baad Noun ki jarurat hai. Dono shabdon mein antar: * Advice (Noun) - सलाह * Advise (Verb) - सलाह देना Atah 'advise' ki jagah 'advice' aayega. (Aakhiri page ka example: I need your advice).

question: Identify the error in the sentence: He has lodged a complain against his noisy neighbors.
solution: lain: Rule (3): 'A' article ke baad Noun aayega, jabki 'complain' verb hai. Dono mein antar: * Complain (Verb) - शिकायत करना * Complaint (Noun) - शिकायत Atah 'complain' ki jagah 'complaint' hoga. (Aakhiri page ka example: I have lodged a complaint against him).

question: Identify the error in the sentence: Bad weather effects your health badly during the winter season.
solution: lain: Rule (4): Yahan verb ki jarurat hai jo asar dalna darshaye. Dono mein antar: * Affect (Verb) - असर करना * Effect (Noun/Verb) - परिणाम/ बदलाव लाना Atah 'effects' ki jagah 'affects' hoga. (Aakhiri page example: Bad weather affects your health and the effect is cough and cold).

question: Identify the error in the sentence: I insure you that I will return your money by next week.
solution: lain: Rule (5): Yahan tasalli dene ki baat ho rahi hai. Teeno shabdon mein antar: * Assure (Verb) - तसल्ली देना * Ensure (Verb) - सुनिश्चित करना * Insure (Verb) - बीमा करना Atah 'insure' ki jagah 'assure' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: Many songs are not worth hearing to, so we should change the playlist.
solution: lain: Rule (6) & Special Rule: Dhyan se sunne ke liye 'listen' aata hai. Dono mein antar: * Hear (Verb) - सुनना * Listen (Verb) - ध्यान से सुनना Aur aakhiri page ke rule ke anusar: "listen के बाद 'to' का प्रयोग होता है लेकिन 'worthlistening' (सुनने के लायक) के बाद नहीं। अतः 'to' हटा दें।" Isliye sahi phrase "worthlistening" hoga bina 'to' ke.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: The medicine will heel the deep cut on your foot very soon.
solution: lain: Rule (7): Ghav theek hone ke liye 'heal' ka prayog hota hai. Dono mein antar: * Heal (Verb) - ठीक होना (घाव या जख्म का) * Heel (Noun) - एड़ी Atah 'heel' ki jagah 'heal' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: The doctor proscribed some rest and antibiotics for the fever.
solution: lain: Rule (8): Doctor salah deta hai, pabandi nahi lagata. Dono shabdon mein antar: * Prescribe (Verb) - सलाह देना * Proscribe (Verb) - पाबंदी लगाना Atah 'proscribed' ki jagah 'prescribed' hoga.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: He is very adopt in playing the guitar and singing songs.
solution: lain: Rule (9): Yahan nipun (expert) hone ki baat hai, jo ek adjective hai. Teeno mein antar: * Adopt (Verb) - गोद लेना * Adapt (Verb) - ढालना * Adept (Adj) - निपुण Atah 'adopt' ki jagah 'adept' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: The clever thief managed to allude the police and escaped into the forest.
solution: lain: Rule (10): Bach nikalne ke liye 'elude' aata hai. Dono mein antar: * Allude (Verb) - के संदर्भ में उल्लेख करना * Elude (Verb) - से बचना Atah 'allude' ki jagah 'elude' aayega. (Aakhiri page example: The thief eluded arrest).

question: Identify the error in the sentence: The publisher amended the manuscript to remove all the spelling errors.
solution: lain: Rule (11): Ashuddhiyan nikalne ke liye 'emend' ka prayog hota hai. Dono mein antar: * Amend (Verb) - संशोधन करना * Emend (Verb) - अशुद्धियाँ निकाल देना Atah 'amended' ki jagah 'emended' hoga.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: I brought a new smartphone from the market yesterday.
solution: lain: Rule (12): Kharidne ke liye buy ki V2 'bought' aati hai. Dono mein antar: * Bought - खरीदना (V2 & V3 form of buy) * Brought - लाना (V2 & V3 form of bring) Atah yahan 'brought' ki jagah 'bought' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: Mirabai comprised many devotional songs dedicated to Lord Krishna.
solution: lain: Rule (13): Banane (rachna karne) ke liye 'compose' aata hai. Dono mein antar: * Compose (Verb) - बनाना * Comprise (Verb) - से बना होना Atah 'comprised' ki jagah 'composed' aayega. (Aakhiri page example: Mirabai composed many songs).

question: Identify the error in the sentence: The value of the currency will deprecate rapidly due to high inflation.
solution: lain: Rule (15): Mulya kam hone ke liye 'depreciate' aata hai. Dono mein antar: * Deprecate (Verb) - नापसंद करना * Depreciate (Verb) - मूल्य कम होना Atah 'deprecate' ki jagah 'depreciate' hoga.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: Please put all the important documents in a sealed envelop.
solution: lain: Rule (16): Lifafe ke liye Noun ki jarurat hai. Dono mein antar: * Envelop (Verb) - ढकना (आवरण करना) * Envelope (Noun) - लिफाफा Atah 'envelop' ki jagah 'envelope' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: The rebel leader excited the angry mob to burn down the building.
solution: lain: Rule (17): Hinsa ke liye bhadkane ko 'incite' kehte hain. Dono mein antar: * Excite (Verb) - उत्तेजित करना * Incite (Verb) - भड़काना Atah 'excited' ki jagah 'incited' hoga.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: She likes to flout her expensive diamond necklace at every party.
solution: lain: Rule (18): Dikhawa karne ke liye 'flaunt' aata hai. Dono mein antar: * Flout (Verb) - उल्लंघन करना * Flaunt (Verb) - दिखावा करना Atah 'flout' ki jagah 'flaunt' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: During the pandemic, people started to horde essential items like food and medicines.
solution: lain: Rule (19): Chhipa kar jama karne ke liye verb 'hoard' ka prayog hota hai. Dono mein antar: * Hoard (Verb) - छिपा कर जमा करना * Horde (Noun) - लोगों का समूह Atah 'horde' ki jagah 'hoard' hoga.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: I am loathe to accept this unfair proposal offered by the committee.
solution: lain: Rule (20): Yahan anichhuk (unwilling) hone ka bhav hai, jo ki Adjective hai. Dono mein antar: * Loathe (Verb) - नापसंद करना * Loath (Adj) - अनिच्छुक Atah 'loathe' ki jagah 'loath' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: Make sure you do not loose your original certificates during the journey.
solution: lain: Rule (21): Khone ke liye Verb 'lose' aata hai. Teeno mein antar: * Lose (Verb) - खोना / हारना * Loss (Noun) - घाटा / हानि * Loose (Adj) - ढीला Atah 'loose' ki jagah 'lose' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: The new harsh policies will certainly mitigate against the welfare of the employees.
solution: lain: Rule (22): Pratikool (against) hone ke liye 'militate' aata hai. Dono mein antar: * Mitigate (Verb) - बेहतर करना (कम कर के) * Militate (Verb) - प्रतिकूल होना Atah 'mitigate' ki jagah 'militate' hoga.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: The hungry lion was silently waiting in the bushes for its pray.
solution: lain: Rule (25): Shikar ke liye 'prey' aata hai. Dono mein antar: * Pray (Verb) - प्रार्थना करना * Prey (Verb/Noun) - शिकार करना / शिकार Atah 'pray' ki jagah 'prey' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: The government decided to wave the farmers' loans due to the severe drought.
solution: lain: Rule (28): Chhoot dene (maaf karne) ke liye 'waive' aata hai. Dono mein antar: * Wave (Noun/Verb) - लहर / लहराना * Waive (Verb) - छूट देना Atah 'wave' ki jagah 'waive' hoga.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: As his car broke down on the highway, he had to toe it to the garage.
solution: lain: Rule (29): Khinch kar le jane ke liye 'tow' aata hai. Teeno mein antar: * Tow (Verb) - खींच कर ले जाना * Toe (Noun) - पैर की अंगुलियाँ * Tiptoe (Verb) - पैर की अंगुलियों पर चलना Atah 'toe' ki jagah 'tow' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: The bomb squad successfully diffused the explosive device before it could explode.
solution: lain: Rule (31): Tanav kam karne ya bomb nishkriya karne ke liye 'defuse' aata hai. Dono mein antar: * Defuse (Verb) - तनाव कम करना * Diffuse (Verb) - फैलाना Atah 'diffused' ki jagah 'defused' hoga.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: He suffered sever head injuries in the horrific car accident last night.
solution: lain: Rule (33): Teevra (bahut adhik) ke liye Adjective 'severe' aata hai. Teeno mein antar: * Sever (Verb) - काट के अलग कर देना * Severe (Adj) - तीव्र * Sewer (Noun) - नाला Atah 'sever' ki jagah 'severe' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: Don't peep constantly at the stranger, it is considered very rude.
solution: lain: Rule (34): Ghoorne ke liye 'stare' aata hai. Inme antar samjhein: * See (Verb) - देखना * Look (Verb) - ताकना/नजर डालना * Stare (Verb) - घूरना * Peep (Verb) - झाँकना/चुपके से देखना * Glare/Glower (Verb) - गुस्से से देखना Atah 'peep' ki jagah 'stare' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: He lighted the candle and lighted the old secret papers in the fireplace.
solution: lain: Rule (35): Jalakar nasht karne ke liye 'burn' ki form 'burnt' aati hai. Dono mein antar: * Light (Verb) - रोशनी प्रज्वलित करना * Burn (Verb) - जलाना (Aakhiri page example: He lighted the candle and burnt the papers). Atah dusre 'lighted' ki jagah 'burnt' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: Please catch this bag for a minute while I tie my shoelaces.
solution: lain: Rule (36): Thehari hui (ruki hui) cheez ko thamne ke liye 'hold' aata hai. Dono mein antar: * Catch (Verb) - किसी गतिशील को पकड़ना * Hold (Verb) - ठहरी हुई चीज को थामना Atah 'catch' ki jagah 'hold' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: The corrupt minister refused the serious allegations levelled against him by the media.
solution: lain: Rule (38): Aaropon ka khandan karne ke liye 'deny' aata hai. Teeno mein antar: * Refuse (Verb) - मना करना * Deny / Refute (Verb) - खंडन करना * Decline (Verb) - अस्वीकार करना/ कम होना (Aakhiri page examples: I refused to help him. The thief denied the charges. I declined the offer). Atah 'refused' ki jagah 'denied' hoga.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: The street vendor was pedaling his cheap goods from door to door.
solution: lain: Rule (39): Ghoom-ghoom kar saman bechne ko 'peddle' kehte hain. Dono mein antar: * Peddle (Verb) - घूम-घूम के सामान बेचना * Pedal (Noun/Verb) - साइकिल में जिस पर पैर रख कर घुमाते है (N), Pedal चलाना (V) Atah 'pedaling' ki jagah 'peddling' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: I bought a new sports car and took my family for a long ride on Sunday.
solution: lain: Rule (40): Char pahiye ki sawari ke liye 'drive' aata hai. Dono mein antar: * Ride (Verb/Noun) - सैर (N) / दोपहिये व जानवर की सवारी करना (V) * Drive (Verb/Noun) - सैर (N) / चार पहिये की सवारी करना (V) Atah 'ride' ki jagah 'drive' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: Due to extreme heat and lack of water, all the beautiful flowers started to weather.
solution: lain: Rule (41): Murjhane ke liye 'wither' aata hai. Inme antar: * Wither (Verb) - मुरझाना * Weather (Noun) - दिन-प्रतिदिन का मौसम * Whether (Conj) - या ...... या ना Atah 'weather' ki jagah 'wither' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: The custom officers decided to cease the smuggled gold at the airport.
solution: lain: Rule (43): Jabt (confiscate) karne ke liye 'seize' aata hai. Dono mein antar: * Cease (Verb) - रूकना * Seize (Verb) - जब्त करना Atah 'cease' ki jagah 'seize' aayega. solution: lain: Book ka exact rule: "Note: listen ke baad 'to' ka prayog hota hai lekin 'worthlistening' (sunne ke layak) ke baad nahi. Atah 'to' hata dein." Isliye 'worthlistening to' galat hai, iski jagah sirf 'worthlistening' aayega.

question: Identify the error in the sentence: The earth's atmosphere comprises of three layers that protect us.
solution: lain: Book ka exact rule: "Active voice mein comprise ke baad 'of' ka prayog nahi hota atah 'of' hata dein." Isliye 'comprises of' galat hai, iski jagah sirf 'comprises' aayega.
